result.reason: The redline reaches the preferred position: it provides up to six months of post-expiry or termination transition assistance at then-current rates, preserves the 30-day machine-readable data-return obligation, and requires secure deletion followed by written officer certification. The change is narrowly confined to replacing the contradictory immediate-cessation and deletion language in Section 11.1, while preserving the detailed export, metadata, fee-dispute, backup, legal-retention, and data-protection provisions in Sections 11.2–11.3. The operative language is clear and professionally drafted.
